id: 2f9d5a70-1b6c-4e8a-9c33-7a0e2f4d1c03
description: Detects creation of the axios/plain-crypto-js RAT dropped artifacts including a renamed PowerShell in ProgramData, system.bat persistence script, and 6202033-named droppers.
references:

  - https://securitylabs.datadoghq.com/articles/axios-npm-supply-chain-compromise/
  - https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/axios-one-rat-to-rule-them-all
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/14

  - attack.t1105
  - attack.defense_evasion

  product: windows
detection:

    TargetFilename|contains: '\ProgramData\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\wt.exe'
      - '\system.bat'
  selection_named:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '6202033.vbs'
      - '6202033.ps1'
  condition: selection_wt or selection_named
level: high

| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in ("FileModified","FileCreated")

          DelayMin=datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, MailTime),
